name: tree-stage1-g2-s45-full-dev-padding-fixed
description: Paper2 FIX: independent full 3001 DEV post-padding audit with batch=1 vs 8 check (single H100, no retraining)
command:
set -euo pipefail
R=/inspire/hdd/global_user/zhangjiaquan-253108540222/baseline/jev
V=/inspire/hdd/global_user/zhangjiaquan-253108540222/research/DiffRwkv/decision_compare/.venv-sii
MODEL=/inspire/hdd/global_user/zhangjiaquan-253108540222/research/DiffRwkv/decision_compare/models/Qwen3.5-4B
export HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1
export TRANSFORMERS_OFFLINE=1
export PYTHONUNBUFFERED=1
export TOKENIZERS_PARALLELISM=false
export PYTHONPATH="$R"
cd "$R"
test "$(git rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD)" = "research/episodic-tree-sokoban-20261027"
test -f "$R/treejev/visual_batching.py"
test -f "$R/treejev/eval_visual_action.py"
mkdir -p "$R/logs/qz"
"$V/bin/python" -m treejev.eval_visual_action \
  --base-model "$MODEL" \
  --adapter "$R/runs/tree/stage1_g2_s45/adapter_best" \
  --dev "$R/runs/tree/valen_split/dev_visual.jsonl" \
  --train-manifest "$R/runs/tree/valen_split/train_visual.jsonl" \
  --output "$R/runs/tree/stage1_g2_s45/full_dev_padding_fixed_20261029.json" \
  --batch-size 8 --batch-check 8 --limit 0 \
  > "$R/logs/qz/tree-stage1-g2-s45-full-dev-fixed.log" 2>&1
